claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM the compound is unlikely to kill cells through AGTR2 antagonism; any observed killing would most plausibly reflect a non-specific physicochemical or off-target cytotoxic effect rather than a receptor-mediated mechanism.
